title: Trump replaces chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller after midterm loss
caption:
Days after Republicans lost control of Congress in the US midterms, President Trump named his deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller as his new White House chief of staff. Susie Wiles, the first woman in the job, moves to Trump's political operation. Miller, a key architect of Trump's immigration policy, starts on Monday, Trump said.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
